tolerance_stacks.name: FT01 joiner in spar socket (diametral clearance, mm)
tolerance_stacks.requirement: > 0 (hand slip fit) and <= 0.30 (shim threshold, hardware.json FT01 action)
tolerance_stacks.verdict: WC fails both limits; RSS passes the lower and fails the upper tail. Acceptable only with M1 measure-select-lap-shim.

tolerance_stacks.name: FT06 joiner in printed saddle bore (diametral clearance, mm)
tolerance_stacks.verdict: WC can interfere; ream/sand on fit (repo action). Needs M2 coupon.

tolerance_stacks.name: Spar socket coaxiality vs joiner (lateral offset at 300 mm engagement, mm)

contributors.item: socket length over which tilt develops

tolerance_stacks.verdict: Socket tilt (1.50 mrad WC) exceeds the joiner tilt allowance (0.76 mrad), so the panel follows the joiner: <= 0.48 mm root-face gap, 0.09 deg, 1.7 mm at the tip (WC). Not binding; bond with the joiner through the saddle to remove it (MFG-06).

tolerance_stacks.name: FT02 boom in printed split clamp (diametral clearance vs 1.2 mm split gap, mm)
tolerance_stacks.requirement: clearance < 1.2 mm so the clamp grips before the halves close

tolerance_stacks.name: FT04 splice plug in boom (diametral clearance, mm) and free tilt
tolerance_stacks.requirement: — (no alignment requirement stated); audit proposes <= 0.25 deg stub misalignment
tolerance_stacks.verdict: Free tilt 0.6 deg nominal, 1.2 deg WC: needs a tighter plug or bonding.

tolerance_stacks.name: J10 M5 x 25 protrusion past the nylock (mm), rev E
tolerance_stacks.requirement: >= 1.6 mm (two 0.8 mm pitches past the nut, cad/params.mjs rev E rule) and screw end inside the lower skin
tolerance_stacks.verdict: Pass: 1.61 mm WC (0.01 mm margin), 1.09 mm inside the skin WC. Requires M5 x 25 screws (an M5 x 20 gives -1.49 mm nominal).
